Population increased in Arun

The estimated population of Arun in 2024 was 170,064 usual residents, a rise of 1.2% since 2023.

This meant that Arun's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Arun increased by 2.9%.

Over this slightly longer period, Arun was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Arun

The average (median) age stayed at 49.9 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Arun has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Arun is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Arun's population of 170,064 usual residents was made up of:

  • 25,825 people aged 0 to 15 years, (15.2%)
  • 94,851 people aged 16 to 64 years, (55.8%)
  • 49,388 people aged 65 years and over, (29%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Arun has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (29% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Arun, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Arun
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Arun, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 1,105 people (-0.7%). In total, there were 1,200 births and 2,305 deaths in Arun.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 2,916 (1.7%). There were 9,977 people entering the area and 7,061 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Arun's population of 190 (0.1%) as a result of 973 people entering the area and 783 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Arun was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Arun in mid-2023 is 168,102.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 143 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 49 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 94 people.
